description: Top partner countries for a Brazilian product in a given year, from MDIC Comex Stat (live proxy). Pass either an 8-digit NCM code or a 2-digit NCM/HS chapter; omit both for Brazil’s overall top trading partners that year. Sorted descending by value (USD FOB). Use for "top destinations for Brazilian soybeans in 2025" (ncm="12019000", year="2025") or "Brazil’s biggest export markets overall in 2025" (year="2025").

chapter.description: 2-digit NCM/HS chapter code (e.g. "12" = oilseeds and grains).

limit.description: Max partner countries to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 50.

ncm.description: Full 8-digit NCM product code (e.g. "12019000" = soybeans). Use this OR chapter, not both; omit both for overall totals.

name: br_trade_top_partners
title: Br Trade Top Partners
